title: Bio-Electric Interface

classification.guidance: Preserve the concept as Lexi.PHYS worldbuilding and convert it into software artifacts: material cards, stress-field visualizations, repair-state simulations, and pitch visuals. Do not present it as literal vacuum engineering or completed quantum hardware.

concept: The Physics of the Bio-Electric Interface The secret to the Aurelian Rig is **Impedance Matching**. Your body’s electrical signals are chaotic and high-impedance. The Rig uses a series of **Tensor-Field Converters** to smooth these signals into a coherent stream. By aligning the geometric orientation of the superconducting traces with the natural vector pathways of your nervous system, we minimize "dark noise." Essentially, we are turning your nervous system into a high-speed fiber-optic cable.

real_build_layer: medical, electrical, and privacy safety checklist
blocked_claims: literal structure draped into the vacuum
using a wearer's bio-electric signature as a real control or authentication field
turning a real nervous system into a data cable or controllable signal bus
body-signal impedance matching as a real medical or neural interface
tensor-field converters as real bio-signal conditioning hardware
wearable superconducting traces aligned to human neural pathways
dark-noise reduction as a validated biological signal treatment
prototype_conversion.first_safe_demo: Create a synthetic signal demo that generates mock noisy waveforms, passes them through a non-medical smoothing filter, and visualizes impedance, noise, and coherence scores without reading or influencing a real nervous system.
